summary: Add force-reboot VM power action (hard guest reset via virsh reset when running). API impact: changed contract; POST /api/v1/vms/{id}/power and vm-power accept force-reboot.

guide.reason: docs/guide/vm-power.md and manage-controller.md list Force reboot beside Shut down / Reboot / Force stop, note hard reset vs ACPI reboot, and troubleshooting when soft reboot is ignored.

api.reason: API impact: changed contract. POST /api/v1/vms/{id}/power and vm-power allow action force-reboot; Core issues virsh reset when the VM is running; interrupt ambiguity matches reboot. docs/API.md and OpenAPI (docs/api/openapi.json) updated; docs/api/index.html regenerated.

roadmap.reason: Extends existing VM power controls; no milestone scope or acceptance status change.

state.reason: No new durable state; power is ephemeral host work against the existing managed VM journal.

verification.method: Unit tests for force-reboot admission and Core reset path; python3 scripts/check_docs.py --worktree. Browser harness updated for the toolbar action; full disposable-lab walkthrough not claimed in this docs slice.
